note: PREREG-V3 plan step A3.d: the declared A3 fetch windows, fixed before any window runs. Every fetch is a child under the contract through the catch-mode proxy, whose catcher tunnels only a window's exact hosts through the declared hop (the auditor's O1 ruling). The a3-hf CDN hosts are fixed from the a3-discovery record by a later commit (Q-A3-3); a redirect to an unlisted host is refused and needs a new ruling.
